title: Evaluate and decide whether to promote Jev audit suppression
description: J8 in docs/plans/jev-integration.md. Define task-specific contradiction rules, exact blocking-source validation, sufficient context requirements, acceptable false-suppression risk bound, and corpus size before a held-out evaluation. Keep suppression disabled until evidence supports a recorded promotion decision.
acceptance_criteria: Document sample size and uncertainty, no missed known-positive regression, unsupported-suppression checks, positive net savings, and per-capability rollback. A no-go outcome is valid; retain/escalate remains available without suppression. Attach held-out benchmrk quality results and joined CodeCrucible cost/latency records using the J3 verification workflow; inspect individual known-positive regressions and report independent iterations, annotation/scorer versions, failed runs, and uncertainty before promotion.

title: Evaluate narrow audit predicates and retain-or-escalate routing
description: J7 in docs/plans/jev-integration.md. Run typed evidence checks beside the full audit in shadow mode. Use separate decision records and explicit eligibility rules for an experimental retain-with-limited-verification path; send unresolved cases to generative audit and repack batches. Preserve original narrative and unverified findings.
acceptance_criteria: Actual request or token reduction is measured; source references validate; Jev confidence never maps to legacy rejection thresholds. Uncertain, conflicting, cross-file, cancelled, and failed cases follow documented policies; no automatic Jev suppression occurs. Attach held-out benchmrk quality results and joined CodeCrucible cost/latency records using the J3 verification workflow; inspect individual known-positive regressions and report independent iterations, annotation/scorer versions, failed runs, and uncertainty before promotion.

title: Retrieve and rank relevant audit evidence
description: J6 in docs/plans/jev-integration.md. Move audit context selection near batch assembly. Retain cited spans and surrounding code, retrieve bounded candidates using lexical/symbol/import metadata within permitted scope, then rank. Treat incomplete call graphs and no-match evidence as coverage gaps.
acceptance_criteria: Required spans remain present; out-of-scope sources cannot enter; incomplete evidence invokes original context/escalation. Per-finding and end-to-end evaluations show acceptable coverage and measured audit cost or quality benefit. Attach held-out benchmrk quality results and joined CodeCrucible cost/latency records using the J3 verification workflow; inspect individual known-positive regressions and report independent iterations, annotation/scorer versions, failed runs, and uncertainty before promotion.

title: Add evidence records and extractive supplementary context
description: J5 in docs/plans/jev-integration.md. Define immutable evidence IDs with exact source text, provenance, source hashes, and ranges. Rank existing passages and pack within actual phase budgets, preserving pinned constraints, headings, qualifications, phase filters, and source opt-in. Start at phase level.
acceptance_criteria: Returned IDs resolve to exact source; missing candidates and oversized pinned context are explicit; failure uses existing configured compression/packing. Held-out evidence coverage and scan quality are maintained with measured cost benefit. Attach held-out benchmrk quality results and joined CodeCrucible cost/latency records using the J3 verification workflow; inspect individual known-positive regressions and report independent iterations, annotation/scorer versions, failed runs, and uncertainty before promotion.

title: Integrate conservative Jev feature detection
description: J4 in docs/plans/jev-integration.md. Derive features from loaded default and custom prompt contracts; evaluate present, absent, or insufficient evidence independently per feature. Add shadow mode before active omission rules; retain always-on and uncertain sections, skip controls, and conservative token budgeting.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover single/multiple chunks, default/custom prompt consumers, absent calibration, empty-list semantics, truncation, and API failure. Held-out evaluation shows no known-positive regression and positive net savings on eligible workloads. Attach held-out benchmrk quality results and joined CodeCrucible cost/latency records using the J3 verification workflow; inspect individual known-positive regressions and report independent iterations, annotation/scorer versions, failed runs, and uncertainty before promotion.

title: Verify Jev efficacy with benchmrk and decision replay tests
description: J3 in docs/plans/jev-integration.md. Use github.com/block/benchmrk for end-to-end SARIF scoring on a versioned, human-reviewed corpus with valid vulnerabilities, invalid decoys, criticality tiers, and repository holdouts. Deliver scanner-variant registration and external-scan/import recipes, explicit experiment/iteration association, a run manifest, and a join to CodeCrucible cost and decision artifacts. Compare Jev off, shadow, individual active capabilities, and combined configurations with pinned inputs and at least three fresh executions per variant/project; increase sample size before promotion. Keep deterministic decision tests and fixed-finding audit replay in CodeCrucible. Live paid runs are explicit.
acceptance_criteria: Provide repeatable benchmrk JSON and readable reports for TP/FP/FN, precision, recall, F1, criticality-tier recall, and reviewed per-vulnerability regressions. Retain corpus/build/model/prompt/policy versions, annotation hash, matcher version, experiment/run/iteration IDs, SARIF hashes, and artifact paths. Join full scan costs and actual scan latency from CodeCrucible, including retries, fallback and unknown billing; import time is not scan latency. Reused SARIF does not count as an independent iteration. Report all incomplete runs and label or matching ambiguities; existing LLM output is not ground truth.

title: Add typed Jev client and opt-in decision configuration
description: J2 in docs/plans/jev-integration.md. Create internal/decision with validated Choice, Noul, and Score contracts, pinned model metadata, separate credentials, request-size limits, cancellation, bounded retries, injectable HTTP transport, and versioned decision artifacts. Introduce only implemented capability settings; default off.
acceptance_criteria: Mock HTTP tests cover all answer types, invalid responses, errors, deadlines, redirects, and request limits. Existing configs make no Jev requests. Jev cannot satisfy generative phase schemas or calibrate analysis token estimates.

title: Account for usage and cost across every scan request
description: J1 in docs/plans/jev-integration.md. Instrument feature detection, compression, analysis, repair, retries, recovery chunks, and all audit batches. Distinguish reported usage, estimated cost, unpriced usage, and unknown billing; retain the existing preflight budget contract.
acceptance_criteria: Request records reconcile once across success and failure paths; baseline total and per-phase report exposes unknown costs; deterministic accounting tests pass.

title: Integrate Jev for bounded CodeCrucible decisions
description: Implement docs/plans/jev-integration.md in staged releases: complete usage accounting, a typed decision client, conservative feature detection, evidence selection, and an evaluated audit cascade. Keep generative vulnerability discovery and deterministic processing in their current roles.
acceptance_criteria: Each enabled capability has measured whole-scan cost and quality results, conservative fallback, versioned decision artifacts, and an independent rollback. Automatic suppression remains disabled until its separate evaluation gate passes.

title: Assess optional semantic grouping and source-span selection
description: J9 in docs/plans/jev-integration.md. Deferred exploration: shortlist duplicate pairs or existing source spans deterministically, then use Jev only for semantic comparison or selection. Preserve original findings and evidence; do not infer transitive duplicate equivalence from pair judgments.
acceptance_criteria: A separate benefit and quality study justifies either a narrowly scoped implementation or a recorded no-go. Exact deduplication, exact lookup, and source coordinates remain deterministic.
